bio: The seafood-focused menu traces the path the chef has taken. He once worked at a fishmonger's to learn the nature of fish and now gets his seafood from that same shop. The meal begins with a soup and tsukuri, after which guests may add dishes to their liking. Octopus is served simmered in a sweet soy-based broth or as karaage, while tilefish is prepared as agedashi or matsukasa-yaki, each prepared in the style best suited to the fish. Items like tekka-maki or squid ink yakisoba bring the meal to a close, allowing guests to enjoy seafood to the very end.
